data.description: Per-container infinite-scroll marquee. Children are duplicated to seamlessly loop.

data-aed-marquee.description: Opt-in marker (presence of the attribute hydrates the container).

data-aed-speed.description: Seconds for one full loop. Lower = faster.

data-aed-variant.description: Preset styling. 'logos' applies the logo-row treatment.

data-aed-pause-on-hover.description: Pause the animation while the cursor is over the container.
